title: The Hollow Colony
author: Kestrel Dunmore
blurb: Cyrus Brightwater, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
